name: transcript1
description: Transcribe YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and 7 more social media platforms, or audio/video files, with timestamps, speakers and free translation. Optional API key; without one, sign in through your browser.
author: transcript1

tools.name: transcribe
tools.title: Transcribe a video
tools.description: Transcribe a YouTube, X, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Bluesky, Twitch, Dailymotion, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Snapchat link. Social posts must be public; only the first video is used. New platforms support public recorded native media without supplied account cookies, not live streams or external embeds. With source "auto", uses native captions when available, otherwise speech-to-text. Captions are available on YouTube, X, TikTok, Bluesky, Dailymotion and LinkedIn when a usable native track exists. Dailymotion supports direct SRT, not caption playlists; Bluesky captions require a supported trusted PDS; LinkedIn supports public native posts, not Learning. Other platforms use speech-to-text. Caption kind is null when authorship is unknown. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 50, max 55) and returns the first transcript page, or an id for get_transcription. Costs 1 minute per started media minute on every platform. If a call fails or times out, find its id with list_transcriptions and call get_transcription instead of transcribe. The same video and options within 24 hours reuse the earlier transcription without another charge; short links may not be matched.

platform.description: Optional; detected from the link. If supplied, must match: "youtube", "x", "tiktok", "instagram", "facebook", "bluesky", "twitch", "dailymotion", "pinterest", "linkedin", "snapchat"

url.description: YouTube, X, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Bluesky, Twitch, Dailymotion, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Snapchat video link; only the first video in a post is used

source.description: "auto" (default): native captions if available, else speech-to-text; "captions": captions only, no STT fallback; "stt": always speech-to-text. Captions are available on YouTube, X, TikTok, Bluesky, Dailymotion and LinkedIn when a usable native track exists. Dailymotion supports direct SRT, not caption playlists; Bluesky captions require a supported trusted PDS; LinkedIn supports public native posts, not Learning. Other platforms use speech-to-text. Caption kind is null when authorship is unknown.

translate_to.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 code. Translates the transcript once it is ready; free. Read it with get_transcription

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result, 0 to 55. Default 50

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.title: Get a transcription
tools.description: Get a transcription's status or its transcript. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 50, max 55) for it to finish. Long transcripts are paged: up to max_chars characters (default 60000) per call; pass the returned next_from_seconds as from_seconds to get the next page.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result, 0 to 55. Default 50

from_seconds.description: Return segments starting at or after this second. Default 0

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of transcript per page, 1000 to 100000. Default 60000

translation.description: With a completed translation: "both" (default; translated line under each original), "only" or "none"

translation_language.description: Two-letter code of the translation to read, e.g. "de". Default: the requested translate_to language, else the latest translation

tools.name: list_transcriptions
tools.title: List transcriptions
tools.description: List recent transcriptions, newest first, without transcripts. Use it to find an id you lost (for example after transcribe timed out) or to see whether a video was already transcribed; use get_transcription to read one job's transcript. Filter by status or platform; pass next_cursor as cursor for more.

status.description: Only transcriptions with this status: awaiting_upload, queued, fetching, transcribing, completed, failed or canceled

platform.description: Only transcriptions from this platform: "youtube", "x", "tiktok", "instagram", "facebook", "bluesky", "twitch", "dailymotion", "pinterest", "linkedin", "snapchat" or "upload"

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous page

tools.name: create_upload
tools.title: Reserve a file upload
tools.description: Reserve a chunked upload for a local audio or video file (mp3, wav, m4a, flac, ogg, opus, mp4, mov, webm, mkv; up to 2 GB). Returns the transcription id, a chunk URL template, an X-Upload-Token and the chunk list. Send the bytes with HTTP PUT outside MCP, then call complete_upload. request_id is a UUID you generate; reuse it to retry safely.

filename.description: File name with its extension, e.g. interview.m4a

request_id.description: A UUID you generate for this upload; reusing it returns the same upload with a fresh token

tools.name: get_upload_status
tools.title: Get upload status
tools.description: Show which chunks of an upload were received. Use it only to resume an interrupted upload or after complete_upload reports upload_incomplete: re-send the missing chunks, then call complete_upload. For transcription progress after the upload, use get_transcription.

tools.name: complete_upload
tools.title: Complete an upload
tools.description: Verify that every chunk arrived and queue the transcription. Call it once, after sending every chunk from create_upload. If it fails with upload_incomplete, call get_upload_status, re-send the missing chunks and call it again. Then call get_transcription to wait for the transcript.

tools.name: delete_transcription
tools.title: Cancel or delete a transcription
tools.description: Cancel a transcription that is still running (minutes taken for it are refunded), or permanently delete a finished one and its transcript and translations. Use it only when the user asks to cancel or delete; it cannot be undone. To stop waiting without canceling, just stop calling get_transcription.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the minutes remaining, the plan and when minutes renew. Call it before starting long or many transcriptions (each started media minute costs 1 minute; translation is free), or after transcribe or complete_upload fails with insufficient_minutes, to tell the user how many remain and when they reset. It does not list or change transcriptions: use list_transcriptions for job history and get_transcription for one job's status or cost.

tools.name: translate_transcription
tools.title: Translate a transcription
tools.description: Translate a completed transcription into another language. Free. Starts in the background and returns the status; call get_transcription to read the result, which shows the translation under each original line.
